item.text: {"question_id":"1B.8","answer":"For the 2023 period, the supplied evidence does not establish a López Obrador-issued crisis decision or personally directed correction of dangerous procedures. It does document institutional safeguards and corrective mechanisms: emergency exercises addressed command and control, decision-making, communications, shelters, hospitals, and transfer to alternate control centers; procedures were updated, lessons learned documented, and emergency plans reviewed. However, a 2019 exercise generated 78 findings, its follow-up was rescheduled, and closure of all findings is not shown. Laguna Verde also had reporting, root-cause, and regulatory-review systems, but the record contains repeated equipment, procedural, human-error, and design weaknesses, with incomplete evidence of final effectiveness. In 2023, stolen radioactive sources were recovered and inspectors verified improved facility security after the March incident; the October theft was reported as an INES-2 event involving degradation of defence in depth, but the supplied record does not provide preventive or corrective-response details. López Obrador was directly associated with a September 2022 proposal for confidence-building and mediation regarding Russia and Ukraine, but that falls outside the target year and the evidence does not establish implementation or effect. The evidence therefore supports institutional preparedness and some corrective action, but not a verified ruler-level 2023 crisis decision, communication safeguard, or personally attributable procedural correction.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0002-E004","BATCH-0002-E007","BATCH-0002-E010","BATCH-0002-E011","BATCH-0002-E012","BATCH-0040-E011"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0038-E002","BATCH-0002-E010","BATCH-0002-E011","BATCH-0002-E012","BATCH-0045-E012","BATCH-0047-E010","BATCH-0008-E006","BATCH-0011-E005"],"limitations_and_gaps":["The supplied evidence does not identify a defined 2023 crisis in which López Obrador personally issued and implemented a de-escalatory decision.","The nuclear preparedness evidence is largely institutional and self-reported, with no direct presidential attribution.","The record does not establish closure of all exercise findings, full completion of specialized preparedness measures, or the effectiveness of corrective systems.","The March 2023 source recovery and security improvements are attributed to regulatory and law-enforcement actors, not personally to López Obrador.","The October 2023 radiological-theft record documents the incident and impacts but not preventive controls, recovery actions, investigation, or correction.","The 2022 diplomatic proposal records advocacy only and does not establish implementation, success, or target-year timing.","The cyber evidence concerns broader governance and institutional safeguards; it does not establish nuclear escalation management or a ruler-level crisis response."],"corrections_made":["Removed the unsupported characterization of institutional exercises and corrective systems as ruler-level crisis safeguards.","Removed the 2022 diplomatic initiative as evidence of a 2023 crisis decision, while retaining it as out-of-period contextual evidence with its implementation limits.","Distinguished the March 2023 source recovery and verified security improvements from the October 2023 theft, for which preventive and corrective responses are not supplied.","Qualified cyber evidence as broader catastrophic-risk governance rather than direct evidence of crisis decision safeguards or nuclear escalation management.","Preserved the evidence of emergency planning, communications, command-and-control, reporting, review, and procedural correction without inferring presidential attribution or effectiveness."],"reasons_to_reopen_full_ledger":["A full ledger review would be warranted if additional evidence identifies a specific 2023 crisis decision personally issued by López Obrador or establishes presidential oversight of nuclear, radiological, or other catastrophic-risk procedures.","Additional records could clarify closure of the 78 exercise findings, completion of FLEX Phase 3 and related measures, and the government's preventive and corrective response to the October 2023 radiological theft.","Further evidence could establish whether the 2022 diplomatic proposal produced implementation or measurable de-escalatory effects."]}
